terrain.rule: h(x,z) = rollingTerrain(x,z) (C Common.cpp) outside the districts; inside a district h = anchor.y + the district's local ground (city: cityTerrain flat core; lake: lakeFloor; lodge pad: flat); the blend ring mixes the two with smoothstep over the ring width. world.vegetation_rule: exactly 100,000 tree/shrub instances and 1,000,000 grass instances in the zone: C's stand trees, city street trees and lake bank trees (within 300 m) are all kept; the forest base (C forest_combat's uniform 100k / 1M in C's order) fills the rest, skipping positions inside district cores (city core, water where lakeFloor < 1.0 for trees / < 0.3 for grass, lodge pad); reeds count as grass. Skipped base instances are not relocated one by one: the fill continues with RppBuild's own deterministic sampler (seed stream 'vegetation') over the allowed ground until the totals are exact. Trees and grass are re-seated on the world terrain (y = h(x,z) + the source's offset).

clear.description: clean air after rain (Hillaire 2020 aerosol); ground-level visibility from aerosol alone ~880 km
clear.ground_albedo_basis: visible-band area mix of the zone seen from above: canopy 70 % (0.045, 0.075, 0.035), grass 15 % (0.08, 0.14, 0.05), urban 10 % (0.15), water 5 % (0.03, 0.04, 0.05) [expected]; RppBuild replaces it with the measured top-down mean of the world's ground and canopy materials

rain.description: light rain R = 2 mm/h lit by a weak sun (horizontally uniform medium; no cloud deck in atmosphere v1): Marshall-Palmer drops plus humid haze; visibility ~4.1 km
rain.derivation: drops: N0 = 8000 m^-3 mm^-1, Lambda = 4.1 R^-0.21 = 3.545 mm^-1, beta_ext = pi N0 / Lambda^3 (Q_ext 2) = 5.64e-4 /m, albedo ~1, g 0.88; haze: beta 3.9e-4 /m (V 10 km), albedo 0.93, g 0.75; one layer: beta_s = 5.64e-4 + 3.63e-4, beta_a = 2.7e-5, g = scattering-weighted mean
rain.ground_albedo_basis: clear mix with wet soil and urban surfaces darkened to ~0.65x and wet vegetation ~0.95x [expected]
rain.sun_transmittance_check: vertical Mie optical depth 1.14; at 28 deg elevation direct sun x ~0.09 (Mie only) [expected]

mist.description: evaporation mist over the lake after rain: shallow fog layer, ground visibility 4 km
mist.derivation: Koschmieder beta_ext = 3.912 / 4000 m; fog droplets r ~ 5 um: albedo 0.998, g 0.85
mist.sun_transmittance_check: vertical optical depth 0.29; at 15 deg direct sun x ~0.32 (Mie only) [expected]
mist.resolution_note: a 300 m scale height is shorter than the J_ms / transmittance altitude spacing near the ground (Bruneton rho grid: first samples ~ 100 m, ~ 380 m): S decides the altitude resolution that keeps the table exact for this state (quality gap = implementation item)
